create_opengauss_client: create an OpenGaussClient instance that connects to an OpenGauss database with pgvector support and initializes the document_chunk table
insert_vector_items: insert a list of VectorItem objects into an OpenGauss collection with cosine-distance-optimized ivfflat indexing
upsert_vector_items: upsert a list of VectorItem objects into an OpenGauss collection, updating existing items by id or inserting new ones
search_similar_vectors: search an OpenGauss collection for similar vectors using cosine distance with optional metadata filtering and top-k limit
delete_collection_items: delete items from an OpenGauss collection by id list, metadata filter, or all items in a collection
